description: This file defines the MenuItemHighlightColors enum that contains styling functions for menu item highlight colors in a SwiftUI macOS application, including color palettes for primary and secondary text colors when menu items are highlighted.

classes.name: MenuItemHighlightColors
classes.description: An enum that provides static methods to obtain highlight colors for menu items, including a nested Palette struct for organizing primary and secondary colors.

methods.name: primary
methods.description: Returns a Color object representing the primary highlight color, depending on whether the item is highlighted.

methods.name: secondary
methods.description: Returns a Color object representing the secondary highlight color with adjusted opacity, depending on whether the item is highlighted.

methods.name: palette
methods.description: Returns a Palette struct containing primary and secondary colors based on the highlighted state.
